steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: You are doing a great job! But you're not well, you need to find a way to get rid of the fire in your body, or you'll never recover! It will cause trouble sooner or later!
You're exhausted, but you've finally avoided the biggest trouble. It's already a mess outside.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Haha, well done! Should have dealt with those gangsters a long time ago! This feels so good.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: If only that damned Reconstruction Executive Committee could actually do something...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Would our life get better? I want to work hard and go out there and do business.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Are you leaving?

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Well... I'd like to make some money out there. I heard that big guy over at the Rust has been taken out as well. If we can really go to Eastside one day, we'll never have to worry about supplies again, right?

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: ...Hmph.

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Haha, but... If I leave, who's gonna make skewers for our cutest Taran boy?
He grabs the leading child and starts rubbing his head. Taran tries to struggle but can't do anything to the beefy butcher.

steps.speaker: Taran
steps.content: Let go, you...

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Are you going to miss me? Haha, you cute little brat!

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: Don't worry! I've lived here for so many years, and when the Syndicate was the most chaotic, Drifter Camp let me sell skewers. How can I leave? There is no better place than here!

steps.speaker: Tally
steps.content: I'll be able to buy quality meat when I get some money. And when I do, you'll be able to get some real Inner Bay skewers, brat!
Everyone starts laughing, but Greta next to you gets teary-eyed all of a sudden.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Sob... I love Drifter Camp... This is the only place that will take us in. I will always love Drifter Camp...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: I think those people are in desperate need of your yooga instructions.

steps.speaker: Greta
steps.content: Oh hey, you're right!
He lifts the curtain and rushes out, and you soon hear Taran's curses. You immediately bolt in the opposite direction while Greta draws everyone's attention. And Dudu is waiting there.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Nicely done this time. I see you didn't need my help.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: She saw someone she knew and went after them.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Oh, I wonder who could get the model worker to leave her commission.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: What should we do? Should we go catch the runaway Sinner or investigate?

steps.speaker: Choice
options: K.K. will be back. Let her do her thing.

steps.speaker: Dudu
steps.content: Well, we have the info, and we've shaken off the trouble, so let's go find the Maniac.
You take one last look back.
The young man who shot at you with a grim look in his eyes has broken free from Tally's embrace. He is still running away from Greta's invitation in a huff.
But instead of the hatred he had when facing your gun, he's wearing a smile that's more suitable for his age.
